name: bb-test-vpc-smoke
author: Amazon Web Services
description: Thin round-trip smoke tests verifying all BBs work in a VPC environment

scripts.test: echo 'VPC smoke tests run during e2e:sandbox:vpc and e2e:production:vpc'
scripts.test:e2e:local: echo 'VPC smoke tests require deployment — skipping local' && exit 0
scripts.test:e2e:sandbox: echo 'Deploy with: NODE_OPTIONS="--conditions=cdk" npx cdk deploy' && exit 0
scripts.test:e2e:production: echo 'Deploy with: NODE_OPTIONS="--conditions=cdk" npx cdk deploy' && exit 0
